board.reason: Linked by the maintainer on 2026-08-17, overriding the computed recommendation of 'none'. The override is correct and the score is not wrong: it measures COORDINATION need — contributors, open items, activity — and coordination need genuinely is low for a solo repository. What it does not measure is TRACKING need. This repository carries 19 tracked items across three distinct categories (gate conditions, thesis risks, architecture questions) with real dependencies between them, and that is what the board is for. Two different needs; the score only sees one.
board.revisit_when: board sits empty with no open issues for an extended period, or the maintainer asks to reconsider

governance_self_binding.$comment: This repository is now governed by its own engine off GitHub issues, not off a local file. Recorded because the previous arrangement was a section 54 failure condition that went unnoticed for 40 commits (ADR-022).
governance_self_binding.consequence: An issue with no milestone reads NOT_ADMITTED and blocks. Correct for the deferrals (6, 14) and for the open questions (1, 2, 5, 20), which are not admitted work.

evidence_run.$comment: Step 5-6 of the ratification directive. First run against a repository this project does not own.
evidence_run.scale: 22 ADRs, 24 open issues, 100 closed (84 NOT_PLANNED / 16 COMPLETED), 2 live milestones
evidence_run.assessment: L4 / GOVERNOR_HIGH_ASSURANCE, floor raised by public_api_surface, release_branches, generated_consumers
evidence_run.worked: Onboarding assessed a foreign repository correctly. Adapters accept targeting via env. decision-history-github read real NOT_PLANNED closures as REJECTED.
evidence_run.failed: Governance itself cannot target a foreign repository and does not say so -- it answers about its own. See issue 24.
evidence_run.structural_finding: Second real-repo run to find a format assumption in adapters/adr. Both were invisible to conformance because the fixtures share the implementation's conventions. Layer 1 and Layer 2 cannot catch a convention the fixtures and the code agree on -- the strongest argument yet for the third-party adapter issue 1 asks for.

cross_repo_audit.$comment: Audit of every adapter for assumptions that break on repositories this project did not write. Prompted by issue 25; the ADR dialect turned out to be one of four classes.
cross_repo_audit.corpus: 437 numbered ADRs across 34 collections in ~/workspace and ~/workspaces
cross_repo_audit.headline: adapters/adr reads 70 of 437 (16%) and reads 10 of those from the wrong part of the document, while passing 136/136 Layer 1 checks.

classes.1_content_format: status dialect -- heading 57%, bullet 19%, inline 16% (only form supported). Issue 25.
classes.2_location: onboard.py proposes binding path=docs/adr; adapters/adr never reads it and defaults to docs/adrs. Issue 27.
classes.3_detection_overpromise: onboard.py substring-counts statuses (20) where the adapter parses (2). Issue 27.
classes.4_identity_default: REPO_GOVERNOR_GH_REPO defaults to tosin2013/repo-governor in two shipped adapters. Issue 26. RELEASE-BLOCKING.

cross_repo_audit.structural_conclusion: A test cannot detect a convention it shares with the implementation. Layer 1 measures contract conformance and says nothing about input coverage; the suite currently carries only one of those properties. Recorded on issue 1.

mechanism_correction.$comment: Maintainer observation 2026-08-17, verified. Refines issue 24 and reorders 27.
mechanism_correction.finding: Every file-backed adapter defaults to a RELATIVE path and resolves it against the working directory, which is correct. engine/bindings.py:98 pins cwd=ROOT to the engine's own install directory, which overrides all seven repo-local providers at once.
mechanism_correction.demonstration: adapters/adr run from the target repo reports 21 documents; the same adapter through the engine reports 24 -- this repository's. Both report path='docs/adrs', so the provenance cannot distinguish them.
mechanism_correction.fix_reordering: Minimal correct fix is cwd, not per-adapter plumbing. Issue 27's path threading remains needed for location variance but must follow 24, not precede it.

agent_surface.$comment: Added 2026-08-17 after the maintainer asked how an LLM would know how to use the skill, then found the better half of the answer: no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md existed, so an agent working here was never told the repository is governed.
agent_surface.pull: SKILL.md -- loads only when the agent decides the skill is relevant. Issue 5's risk.
agent_surface.push: AGENTS.md -- loaded automatically for every agent in the repository. CLAUDE.md is a one-line pointer, not a copy: content in the vendor file would be the bet section 54 warns against.
agent_surface.checked_by: conformance/skill.py -- executes what the surface documents rather than grepping it. Caught four unmarked citations of Proposed ADRs on its first run.
agent_surface.not_done: engine/onboard.py does not propose an AGENTS.md stanza, so only hand-edited repositories get the push half. Issue 27's territory, and the thing that would make governance reach agents in arbitrary repositories.

program.beads_discipline: Issue 33 defines the Stage E experiment and delivers a go/no-go on the Beads adapter. no-go is a successful outcome. The adapter build is NOT admitted and must not be until necessity is argued.
